judges.name: PLAN fidelity
judges.description: Verifies the iteration's deliverables match what PLAN.md (and the current phase doc) actually asks for. Flags scope drift early.
judges.prompt: You are scoring an iteration against the Mockingbird PLAN. Read PLAN.md (spine) and docs/phases/phase{N}.md, then read STATUS.md and the last commit's diff. Score 0-10 on PLAN fidelity. Explicitly cite any deliverable the iteration claimed-done that the PLAN does NOT actually mandate, and any PLAN mandate the iteration silently skipped. Reply in JSON: {score, summary, drift_in[], drift_out[], next_action}.

judges.name: Invariant guard
judges.description: Checks the eight binding invariants from AGENTS.md are respected by the iteration's diff.
judges.prompt: Examine the iteration's diff (git diff against the previous tag or commit). For each of these invariants, report PASS / FAIL / N/A with a one-line justification: (1) raw transcripts immutable; (2) provenance total; (3) layers replaceable; (4) no telemetry; (5) cross-platform abstractions; (6) clipboard save/restore around paste; (7) secure-input fields abort injection; (8) no @tanstack/* dependency. Reply in JSON: {invariants:{name, status, note}, overall}.

judges.name: Quality bar
judges.description: Verifies fmt/clippy/tests are green AND the iteration didn't disable any lint/test to make them green.
judges.prompt: Read the diff. Confirm: (a) cargo fmt clean (no .rustfmt.toml relaxation), (b) clippy clean WITHOUT any new #[allow] without a justifying comment, (c) tests pass AND none were marked #[ignore] or deleted, (d) test count went up or stayed equal to LOC growth ratio. Reply in JSON: {fmt, clippy, tests, suppressed_lints[], deleted_tests[], verdict}.

judges.name: STATUS.md hygiene
judges.description: Confirms STATUS.md was updated and contains the required sections (task progress, cost line, blocked-on, last-judge).
judges.prompt: Open STATUS.md. Confirm it includes: current phase, last-updated date, completed tasks for this iteration, an updated cost line, a Blocked-on section, and a Last-successful-judge-run line. Reply in JSON: {present:{phase, updated, completed, cost, blocked, last_judge}, missing_sections[]}.

judges.name: STT correctness (Phase 2)
judges.description: Verifies the Whisper STT pipeline produces a non-fabricated transcript that matches expected output within edit-distance tolerance on a known speech fixture. Hard-blocks the phase-2-complete tag.
judges.prompt: Open docs/judges/phase-2/stt-correct.md and follow its pass criteria. Run `cargo test --workspace -- whisper::` and check the three integration tests pass. If a real-speech fixture exists at tests/fixtures/audio/hello.wav with a .expected.txt sidecar, run `target\release\stt_test.exe tests/fixtures/audio/hello.wav --json`, parse the JSON, lowercase + whitespace-normalise the .text field, and compute Levenshtein edit distance against the sidecar. Pass if distance <= 25% of expected length AND model_id == 'whisper-large-v3-turbo-q5_0' AND latency_ms > 0. Reply in JSON: {tests_pass, fixture_match, edit_distance, expected_length, model_id_ok, latency_ok, verdict, notes}.

judges.name: CUDA verified (Phase 2)
judges.description: Verifies that Whisper actually uses GPU (cuBLAS / CUDA) on this device — not silently falling back to CPU. Hard-blocks the phase-2-complete tag per PLAN line 1362.
judges.prompt: Open docs/judges/phase-2/cuda-verified.md. Verify ALL of: (1) Cargo.toml has whisper-rs with features=["cuda"] active (not commented out); (2) `cargo build --release --bin stt_test` succeeds with cuda backend; (3) Running the binary on a speech WAV emits a stderr line matching /CUDA|cuBLAS|gpu_device|cudart/ AND does NOT emit 'use gpu = 0' or 'no GPU found'; (4) The --json output has gpu_used:true. Each criterion is binary pass/fail. Reply in JSON: {cargo_feature_on, build_ok, runtime_cuda_lines:[...], gpu_used_json, verdict, blocker_reason}.

judges.name: STT performance budget (Phase 2)
judges.description: Verifies end-to-end transcribe latency < 1000 ms for 10s of speech audio on GPU. PLAN line 1376 budget. Gated behind cuda-verified — CPU runs are informational only.
judges.prompt: Open docs/judges/phase-2/perf-stt.md. If the cuda-verified judge passed in this iteration, run `cargo bench --bench whisper_latency` and parse the criterion JSON output at target/criterion/whisper_latency_*/new/estimates.json. Pass if mean point_estimate (in ns, divide by 1_000_000 for ms) is < 1000 AND p95 < 1500 on a 10-second speech fixture. If only the synthetic sine fixture exists, report 'fixture-missing' and mark NOT_RUN (not FAIL). If cuda-verified did NOT pass, mark NOT_RUN and explain the gating. Reply in JSON: {cuda_gate_ok, mean_ms, p95_ms, fixture_used, verdict}.

judges.name: Meeting formatter is deterministic (Phase MC)
judges.description: Verifies that the meeting transcript formatter is pure and deterministic: same input yields byte-identical output, and `format(format(x)) == format(x)` for any reasonable input. Hard-blocks the phase-mc-complete tag.
judges.prompt: Open docs/judges/phase-mc/mc-formatter-deterministic.md and follow its pass criteria. (1) Run `pwsh scripts/cargo-with-cuda.ps1 test --release --lib -- meetings::formatter::tests` and confirm all 31 unit tests + 2 proptests pass. (2) Run the static-purity grep against formatter.rs and filler_words.rs; expect zero matches for std::time / Instant / SystemTime / thread_rng / rand:: / Once / OnceCell / OnceLock / env:: / getenv. (3) Confirm FILLER_WORDS is a const-init phf::phf_set!, not a Lazy<HashSet>. Reply in JSON: {pass: bool, tests_passed: int, proptest_pass: bool, static_purity_clean: bool, phf_set_used: bool, notes: string}. FAIL blocks phase-mc-complete tag.

judges.name: Meeting long-form stitching is lossless (Phase MC)
judges.description: Verifies the chunked Whisper driver stitches multi-chunk feeds losslessly: every ground-truth word appears exactly once across chunk seams (no gaps, no duplicates from the 2s overlap region). Hard-blocks the phase-mc-complete tag per ADR 0029.
judges.prompt: Open docs/judges/phase-mc/mc-long-form-stitched-losslessly.md and follow its pass criteria. (1) Run `pwsh scripts/cargo-with-cuda.ps1 test --release --lib -- meetings::long_form_stt_tests meetings::long_form_stt_pure_tests` and confirm all 23 tests pass including lossless_synthetic_long_feed_no_gaps_no_dupes and two_channels_yield_independent_segment_streams. (2) Inspect the test source to confirm the lossless assertion really walks ground-truth segments and asserts exactly-once presence in the stitched output. Reply in JSON: {pass: bool, tests_passed: int, lossless_test_pass: bool, two_channel_test_pass: bool, notes: string}. FAIL blocks phase-mc-complete tag.

judges.name: Two-channel merge correctness (Phase MC)
judges.description: Verifies the cross-channel chronological merge produces a single labeled transcript: mic vs system speaker labels round-trip from settings, paragraphs are in t0_ms order, mic wins on ties, and the export layer respects the merge output. Hard-blocks the phase-mc-complete tag per ADR 0028.
judges.prompt: Open docs/judges/phase-mc/mc-two-channel-merged.md and follow its pass criteria. (1) Run `pwsh scripts/cargo-with-cuda.ps1 test --release --lib -- meetings::merge::tests` and confirm all 12 merge tests pass including custom_labels_substitute_for_defaults and default_label_strings_match_settings_default_values. (2) Run the export tests both_renders_merged_when_present, both_falls_back_to_interleave_when_merge_missing, system_source_uses_custom_sys_label, both_fallback_uses_custom_labels_when_merged_missing. (3) Verify merge_two_channels signature takes a SpeakerLabels parameter (not hardcoded constants) and that lifecycle.rs + commands/meetings.rs both read SpeakerLabels::load(&conn) before calling the merge / render_markdown. Reply in JSON: {pass: bool, merge_tests_passed: int, export_tests_passed: int, signature_threads_labels: bool, notes: string}. FAIL blocks phase-mc-complete tag.

judges.name: No LLM in meeting critical path (Phase MC)
judges.description: Verifies the recording-to-canonical-transcript pipeline never constructs an OllamaProvider, never imports crate::cleanup::*, and never gates the meeting:state=done emit on an LLM call. The optional LLM pass lives only in llm_pass.rs reachable via meeting_run_llm_pass. Hard-blocks the phase-mc-complete tag per ADR 0026.
judges.prompt: Open docs/judges/phase-mc/mc-no-llm-in-critical-path.md and follow its pass criteria. (1) Run `Select-String -Path src-tauri/src/meetings/*.rs -Pattern 'OllamaProvider'` and confirm every match is either in meetings/llm_pass.rs or in a doc-comment line that names the invariant. (2) Run `Select-String -Path src-tauri/src/meetings/*.rs -Pattern '^use crate::cleanup'` and confirm every match is in meetings/llm_pass.rs. (3) Static-grep the critical-path file set (lifecycle/runtime/persist/long_form_stt/formatter/merge/chunker/capture) for OllamaProvider / run_llm_pass / LlmCleaner / reqwest:: / ureq:: — expect zero live matches (doc-comment lines naming the invariant are OK). (4) Confirm migration 011_meeting_capture.sql has no llm_output / llm_text / llm_summary columns. Reply in JSON: {pass: bool, ollama_isolated_to_llm_pass: bool, cleanup_imports_isolated: bool, critical_path_clean: bool, schema_has_no_llm_column: bool, notes: string}. FAIL blocks phase-mc-complete tag.

judges.name: Dictation subsystem untouched (Phase MC)
judges.description: Verifies Phase MC commits did not modify any sealed dictation file (hotkey state/windows/driver, dictation/, injection/, recording_window.rs, cleanup/provider.rs, cleanup/llm_cleaner.rs, migrations 001-010). Diff is scoped phase-mc-start..HEAD (NOT phase-4-complete..HEAD, since lateral epics legitimately touched some files between those refs). Hard-blocks the phase-mc-complete tag.
judges.prompt: Open docs/judges/phase-mc/mc-dictation-untouched.md and follow its pass criteria. (1) Run `git diff --name-only phase-mc-start..HEAD --` over the sealed file set; expect empty output (hotkey/probe.rs is ALLOWED per ADR 0027 — it's not in the seal set). (2) Run the same diff over src/db/migrations/001-010_*.sql; expect empty. (3) Confirm migration 011 has no INSERT INTO modes / ALTER TABLE modes. (4) `git diff phase-mc-start..HEAD -- src-tauri/src/cleanup/{provider,llm_cleaner,ollama}.rs` — expect empty diff. (5) Run the dictation/cleanup/injection test suite via cargo-with-cuda.ps1 and confirm zero regressions vs phase-4-complete. Reply in JSON: {pass: bool, sealed_files_untouched: bool, sealed_migrations_untouched: bool, no_modes_changes: bool, cleanup_untouched: bool, dictation_tests_green: bool, notes: string}. FAIL blocks phase-mc-complete tag.

judges.name: Supply-chain hygiene
judges.description: If package.json, package-lock.json, Cargo.toml, or Cargo.lock changed, audits the new deps against the IOC list and the project's banned-namespace rules.
judges.prompt: Examine the diff for changes to package.json, package-lock.json, Cargo.toml, or Cargo.lock. For each added/upgraded dep, check: (a) not in @tanstack/* namespace, (b) not in the PLAN Appendix D IOC list, (c) lockfile updated alongside, (d) no install scripts enabled. Reply in JSON: {npm_changes[], cargo_changes[], violations[], verdict}.
